episodes.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
episodes.summary: At a Congressional hearing, the story of a mysterious White House death — and the brilliant detective hired to crack the case — begins to unfold.

episodes.title: Dial M for Murder
episodes.summary: From celebrities and Cabinet members to plumbers and pastry chefs, everyone is in the hot seat as Cordelia conducts interviews.

episodes.title: Knives Out
episodes.summary: Simmering conflicts in the White House kitchen offer Cordelia a delicious opportunity to uncover clues.

episodes.title: The Last of Sheila
episodes.summary: Irrepressible butler Sheila has risen from Waffle House to the White House. But her misbehavior at the state dinner arouses Cordelia's suspicions.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Harry
episodes.summary: A surprise tip points Cordelia to three of the President's lesser-known housemates: his brother Tripp, his mother-in-law Nan and his top advisor, Harry.

episodes.title: The Third Man
episodes.summary: As dawn breaks, Cordelia faces pressure to end the residence's lockdown. Meanwhile, in the present day, a fresh testimony upends the Senate hearing.

episodes.title: The Adventure of the Engineer's Thumb
episodes.summary: Elsyie, a housekeeper, is the most-liked employee in the residence. But Cordelia suspects there's more to her than meets the eye.

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Yellow Room
episodes.summary: As the clock ticks down on her investigation, Cordelia is ready to reveal the murderer in the residence — even if she has to do it on the fly.
